concerns.text: FR-006 ('Real Data Integration') and US4 ('Real Data Acquisition') require the system to fetch actual VR logs from verified sources. Tasks T092 and T092-Placeholder in Phase 6 are marked 'Archived' or 'Deferred' with no active implementation tasks to implement the actual fetching logic. The requirement is acknowledged but has no corresponding executable task to satisfy the 'fetch' mandate.

FR-006 mandates a 'Real Data Mode' that fetches actual VR logs and fails loudly if unavailable. While T095 implements a gate, the active execution path in Phase 3 (T013, T014) generates synthetic data. There is no active task to implement the 'fetch actual VR logs' logic for the Real Data Mode, leaving the core requirement unimplemented in the current execution path.

Task T092 is listed as 'Archived' with the reason 'No verified real VR log dataset is available.' However, FR-006 and US4 explicitly require the system to support fetching real VR logs and failing loudly if missing. Archiving the implementation task without a corresponding Spec Amendment task (other than T090 which covers the simulation fallback) leaves the requirement for the 'fetch' capability itself unaddressed in the task list.
